---
title: "Actions to take after cloning the project from Github"
---

Great job! You have successfully cloned the project from Github. Here are the next steps to practice with git and boost your git ability.

Step 1:

Write your self-introduction in Self Introductions.qmd

Step 2:

Try rendering the qmd file, and you will see a website pop up

Step 3:

Go to Terminal, type

```{r}
git commit -am "message describing the changes you made"
```

and hit enter. Now you commit all the changes you made!

Step 4:

In the terminal, type

```{r}
git push
```

and hit enter. Now all your changes are pushed to Github repository! Go to the project page and check if the content is updated!
